status: PROPOSED (ODR-R10-06): binding once the owner pins its sha256 as deadlinePolicy.sha256 in the lock
rule: The T0 record is committed once, at T0, before any other rehearsal commit, and never changed. stop-decision and resume take --t0-record and --deadline-policy; a claimed T0 or window that differs is DEADLINE_RESET. Recovery, container loss and agent replacement continue against the original deadline.

computeLimit.rule: A stated compute budget is not a stop condition. Stopping on compute needs a separate owner record {action: approve-compute-limit, decision_id, limit} and evidence that the limit is reached (stop-decision reason compute-limit).
